transferable_principles: Provide geographic contrast immediately, with one dominant target.
Name or otherwise hint the next focus before the camera gets there.
Keep camera travel continuous but change speed: context → faster dive → slower reading interval.
Place fresh directional/state information after the geography becomes legible.
Let one reveal packet finish before the next information layer.
Do not copy thick country colors, specific captions, default arrows or export-card ending.
